Implementation Plan

Actions taken:
- Reviewed item 2 in `docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md` plus the current prompt-render and reviewer-prompt flow in `scripts/render_prompt.sh`, `scripts/render_prompt.py`, and `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh`.
- Clarification mapping: no Q-IDs were asked; the auto `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` leaves the original scope unchanged.
- Ref check: HEAD `56ff5b270613d547b6b389b13b8eae8e9b914c58` on `orchestrator/project-3376`, which matches the integration-branch metadata.

Assumptions:
- Keep the PR limited to the six listed paths only.
- Keep the feature reviewer-only; do not wire `MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY` into editor, judge, summariser, workflows, docs, or templates.
- Follow existing additive patterns already used for prompt assets and placeholder shims.

Implementation plan

1. Files likely to change
- `prompts/overlays/gpt.txt` [new]
- `prompts/overlays/claude.txt` [new]
- `prompts/overlays/gemini.txt` [new]
- `prompts/overlays/other.txt` [new]
- `scripts/render_prompt.sh`
- `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh`

2. Functions/modules to implement
- In `scripts/render_prompt.sh`:
  - add explicit `MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY` handling next to the existing workflow/SEMBLE/SERENA placeholder branches
  - resolve it from `${MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY}` with an empty-string default
  - pass it through `append_render_var` even when unset/empty so a caller using `{{MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY}}` never leaves the placeholder unresolved
  - add matching legacy/sentinel comments alongside the existing placeholder contract comments

- In `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh`:
  - add a small model-family resolver for reviewer slugs:
    - `openai/*` -> `gpt.txt`
    - `anthropic/*` -> `claude.txt`
    - `google/*` or `*/gemini-*` -> `gemini.txt`
    - everything else -> `other.txt`
  - add overlay-file lookup using the same support-path fallback style already used for reviewer prompt assets
  - read the chosen overlay file body and export `MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY` before rendering that reviewer’s prompt
  - add the reviewer-side placeholder insertion point so the overlay is appended only in the reviewer flow
  - make prompt rendering per reviewer slot (or per reviewer-specific prompt copy), not once globally before fan-out

3. Overlay contents to land
- `gpt.txt`: persistence, critical thinking between steps, concise final reply
- `claude.txt`: `todo_write` discipline, mark-complete-per-item, unattended no-STOP-and-ASK bridge
- `gemini.txt`: keep non-tool prose short, get to action quickly, preserve expected severity labels
- `other.txt`: minimal fallback covering severity-label format and “no clarification questions”

4. Data structures / internal contracts affected
- new optional env var contract: `MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY` as a string payload
- new slug-to-overlay mapping logic in reviewer setup
- new prompt asset directory contents under `prompts/overlays/`
- no DB/schema/workflow-input/API shape changes

5. API or interface changes
- backward-compatible internal renderer extension: `scripts/render_prompt.sh` now understands `{{MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY}}`
- no existing placeholder names are removed or renamed
- no new callers beyond reviewer prompt assembly

6. Two-commit execution order
- Commit 1: add `prompts/overlays/*.txt` plus the dormant `MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY` branch in `scripts/render_prompt.sh`
- Commit 2: wire reviewer-family selection in `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh`, add the reviewer-side placeholder insertion, and render/export the selected overlay per reviewer slot

7. Risks and edge cases
- Empty-overlay regression: `render_prompt.py` turns a standalone empty placeholder into a blank line, so the reviewer insertion point must preserve byte-identical output when the overlay is empty/unset.
- Shared-render bug: the current reviewer-body render happens before model fan-out; if left global, every reviewer would inherit the same overlay.
- Parallel isolation: reviewer workers run concurrently, so overlay contents and any rendered prompt temp files must stay slot-local.
- Path fallback: overlay lookup should follow existing support-root/support-prompts fallback behavior, not repo-root-only assumptions.
- Coverage skew: the current default reviewer roster is third-party-only, so normal review runs naturally exercise `other.txt`; GPT/Claude/Gemini paths need targeted smoke coverage.

8. Testing considerations
- Regression smoke for commit 1: confirm an existing prompt with no new placeholder still renders identically before/after the shell-shim change.
- Reviewer-path smoke for commit 2: force representative reviewer slugs and inspect rendered reviewer prompt output for one GPT-family, one Claude-family, one Gemini-family, and one fallback model.
- Negative smoke: verify no literal `{{MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY}}` survives in rendered reviewer prompts and no extra blank line appears when the overlay is intentionally empty.
- Rerun the existing `render_prompt` regression coverage in `tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py` if the pinned test environment is available.
- Do not plan on adding new test files in this PR; `files_touched` excludes tests.

Conflicts / codebase notes
- No integration-ref conflict found.
- `prompts/overlays/` does not exist yet and must be created by the four new files.
- Current reviewer prompt rendering is structurally incompatible with per-family overlays unless the render step becomes reviewer-specific.

Missing-context notes
- No blocker. The needed family-specific overlay guidance is present in the referenced plan item.

Pre-execution self-check
PLAN_SELF_CHECK: WARNING: The allowed file scope excludes test files, so verification of the new overlay path must rely on existing suites plus targeted smoke unless scope is broadened.
